name: Marylebone / Marble Arch
blurb: Home base. Selfridges, Marylebone Lane, Wallace Collection, Hyde Park all within 10 min.

name: Soho & Carnaby
blurb: Streetwear central: Supreme, Palace, Stüssy, ALD, END., Footpatrol, plus Berwick Street record shops.

name: Covent Garden & Seven Dials
blurb: Seven Dials has Carhartt WIP and sneaker/sportswear shops; the piazza has street performers.

name: Mayfair & Regent Street
blurb: Savile Row tailors (the Kingsman shop), Regent Street flagships, Kith London.

name: St James's & Piccadilly
blurb: Dover Street Market on Haymarket, Piccadilly Circus, and the walk down to Trafalgar Square.

name: Fitzrovia
blurb: Quieter streets north of Oxford St with good restaurants and Passyunk Avenue for US sports.

name: Westminster
blurb: Big Ben, Westminster Abbey, Parliament, Buckingham Palace down the Mall. Easy to do in one loop on foot.

name: South Bank
blurb: London Eye, the Southbank skatepark undercroft, BFI Southbank and the BFI IMAX, riverside walk to Tate Modern.

name: Borough & Bankside
blurb: Borough Market (closes 16:00 Sun), Tate Modern, Shakespeare's Globe, Millennium Bridge.

name: Bermondsey
blurb: Maltby Street Market under the railway arches (weekends): smaller, cooler cousin of Borough.

name: Tower Bridge & Tower of London
blurb: Walk across Tower Bridge; Tower of London and the Crown Jewels on the north side.

name: The City
blurb: Leadenhall Market (Diagon Alley in Harry Potter), Sky Garden (free, booking needed), St Paul's.

name: Brick Lane & Spitalfields
blurb: Vintage shops, Rough Trade East, Goodhood, Beigel Bake, street art everywhere. Best on Sunday.

name: Shoreditch
blurb: Boxpark, independent boutiques, bars, Dishoom Shoreditch, murals on every corner.

name: Chelsea & King's Road
blurb: King's Road shopping, Saatchi Gallery (free), Duke of York Square. Kutir is here.

name: Fulham / Stamford Bridge
blurb: Chelsea FC's Stamford Bridge: stadium tour and museum, 20 min walk from Kutir.

name: Knightsbridge & South Ken
blurb: Harrods, the V&A and the Natural History Museum (both free).

name: Hyde Park
blurb: Big green reset between shopping runs. Speakers' Corner is by Marble Arch.

name: Notting Hill
blurb: Portobello Road (Saturday is the big market day), pastel houses, the Notting Hill bookshop.

name: Camden
blurb: Camden Market, vintage stalls, street food, the Roundhouse. Primrose Hill views nearby.

name: King's Cross
blurb: Platform 9¾, Coal Drops Yard shops, canal-side hangouts.

name: St John's Wood / Abbey Road
blurb: The Abbey Road crossing and studios. Take the photo, mind the traffic.

name: Highbury / Emirates
blurb: Arsenal's Emirates Stadium: tour and museum (not on home match days).

name: Stratford
blurb: Olympic Park, London Stadium, Westfield Stratford City.

name: Heathrow
blurb: Airport.
